Official average hiring-process duration: about 60 days (2024 post; re-verify — now over 6 months old per Doc 3 freshness rules).

thesis_text: Bottom line: Coinbase is the most explicitly gated process in this batch — a company-stated ~5% pass-through at application review, a benchmarked cognitive/culture assessment plus CodeSignal for engineering, and executive sign-off on every offer. Preparation should treat the assessment gate and resume clarity as first-class hurdles, not formalities. Who gets in (sourced numbers only): no hire-population numbers are claimed — school/feeder/major shares are omitted for lack of a public sample. Sourced numbers are Coinbase's own (March 2024): about 5% of applications progress past review, the process averages about 60 days, the structured assessment takes about 30 minutes, and panels run up to four 1:1 interviews. Stated vs revealed screens: this record relies on stated screens only — Coinbase publishes its process in unusual detail, but no fetched source independently reveals how the benchmark cutoffs are set, so no revealed-screen claim is made. Stated screens: high-impact, clearly communicated track record; mission resonance and cultural-tenet alignment at the recruiter screen; benchmarked assessment results. Ranked entry routes: (1) direct application through the published process, (2) referral — listed only as unquantified; no official referral track was sourced. Timeline/dates (as of 2026-10-12): the process source is date-stamped 2024-03-19 and is stale by Doc 3 standards — re-verify stages and the 60-day average before relying on them. Risks/alternatives: assessment benchmarking is opaque and the bar is explicitly 'leave the seat empty' — candidates should parallel-track other remote-first fintech/infrastructure employers. Gap analysis vs a specific user is not computed here (no population sample).
known_biases_of_data: Single-source risk: nearly all process facts come from one official employer post (2024); employer-published funnel figures (e.g., ~5%) are company-stated and unaudited.
Staleness: the main source is >6 months old at verification; Coinbase may have changed stages since.
Official culture page could not be fully fetched (limited body text returned), so culture claims are restricted to the interview post.
No H-1B LCA, university-outcome or licensed population data was fetched in this pass; survivorship/self-report biases would apply to any future population layer and are pre-registered here.
